transcript: My friend, when things begin to go well, this is the moment to become even more calm. Do not rush into pride. Do not stand on the mountain and shout that you have arrived. I have watched many people rise, and I have watched many fall. They come and they go. So walk gently. Receive what is good in your life with gratitude, not with grasping. Move forward slowly, carefully, with awareness. Do not overextend yourself just because today feels strong. There is no final position, no permanent safety. Life is movement, and humility keeps you balanced. Be thankful for what you have, then take the next step with quiet respect.
